proposal.summary: IDOR vulnerability allows unauthorized access to other customers' orders by changing the order ID in the API request.
proposal.cwe_quote: Access to a resource is improperly controlled.

AV.quote: The vulnerability can be exploited over the network.

AC.quote: The attacker can exploit the vulnerability without any special conditions.

PR.quote: No authentication is required to access the orders.

S.quote: The impact does not cross a security boundary.

C.quote: Changing the ID shows other customers' orders including addresses.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Implement proper access controls to restrict order visibility based on user authentication.

evidence_quotes.claim: Access to other customers' orders is possible by changing the ID.
evidence_quotes.quote: changing the id shows other customers' orders including addresses.
